import copy,hashlib,io,json,os,subprocess,sys,unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
pipe=Path('scripts/repair_gmyhf_missing_pair.py');rules=Path('scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py');originals={p:p.read_text() for p in (pipe,rules)}
writer='tests.test_gmyhf_missing_pair.MissingPairWriterTests.';proof='tests.test_gmyhf_missing_pair.MissingPairProofTests.'
cases=[
(pipe,'接管无缺失证明的同名输入',"else:require(names==old_names,'没有原始缺失证明，不接管已经存在的3.in')","else:pass",writer+'test_existing_new_input_without_absence_proof_is_rejected'),
(pipe,'忽略缺失证明计划哈希',"require(json.loads(binding_path.read_text())==binding,'缺失状态备份与当前计划或配置变化')","None",writer+'test_modified_absence_binding_prevents_writes'),
(pipe,'忽略原件回读变化',"require(sha(live) in (digest,expected[name]),'已有文件出现未审核变化')","pass",writer+'test_original_file_drift_prevents_all_writes'),
(pipe,'忽略最终配置变化',"require(configuration_sha(page)==fingerprint and listed_files(page,NUMBER)==final_names,'最终配置或清单变化')","pass",writer+'test_configuration_change_stops_completion_then_retry_resumes'),
(pipe,'忽略最终非目标文件变化',"require(sha(raw)==digest,'最终全文件回读不符')","None",writer+'test_final_unrelated_file_drift_never_claims_completion'),
(pipe,'未即时回读也记录成功',"require(sha(platform.download(session,NUMBER,name))==expected[name],'上传后回读不符')","pass",writer+'test_failed_upload_never_claims_completion'),
(pipe,'未经参考哈希审核即执行',"require(sha(source.encode())==proof['sha256'] and proof.get('language','python3')=='python3','自写参考来源或语言不符')","pass",proof+'test_prepare_restores_alias_and_preserves_all_answers'),
(pipe,'复制时破坏原完整数据对',"(target/'data'/name).write_bytes(raw)","(target/'data'/name).write_bytes(b'broken')",proof+'test_prepare_restores_alias_and_preserves_all_answers'),
(pipe,'不验证错名输入与孤立答案成对',"require(answer==(target/'data'/OUTPUT).read_bytes(),'错名输入与原孤立答案不匹配')","pass",proof+'test_prepare_restores_alias_and_preserves_all_answers'),
(pipe,'默认即写平台',"if not apply:return","if False:return",writer+'test_default_is_readonly_and_saves_original_absence'),
(rules,'错名输入允许单元素deque','assert 2 <= n <= 10**5 and 0 <= q <= 3*10**5','assert 1 <= n <= 10**5 and 0 <= q <= 3*10**5',proof+'test_alias_contract_rejects_malformed_or_out_of_range_content'),
(rules,'错名输入忽略数据长度','assert len(values) == 2 + n + q','assert True',proof+'test_alias_contract_rejects_malformed_or_out_of_range_content'),
(rules,'错名输入允许零查询','assert all(1 <= x <= 10**18 for x in values[2+n:])','assert all(0 <= x <= 10**18 for x in values[2+n:])',proof+'test_alias_contract_rejects_malformed_or_out_of_range_content')]

results=[]
try:
 for p,name,old,new,test in cases:
  assert originals[p].count(old)>=1,(name,originals[p].count(old));p.write_text(originals[p].replace(old,new))
  run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest',test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
  assert run.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode});p.write_text(originals[p])
finally:
 for p,s in originals.items():p.write_text(s)
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()));from tests.test_gmyhf_missing_pair import MissingPairProofTests
entry=next(e for e in json.loads(Path('collab/gmyhf-pending-batch12-review.json').read_text())['entries'] if e['global_number']==27934);entry=copy.deepcopy(entry)
entry['authored_reference']['source']=entry['authored_reference']['source'].replace('query - len(prefix) - 1','query - len(prefix)')
entry['authored_reference']['sha256']=hashlib.sha256(entry['authored_reference']['source'].encode()).hexdigest()
with patch('tests.test_gmyhf_missing_pair.json.loads',return_value={'entries':[entry]}):
 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(MissingPairProofTests('test_authored_case_and_reference_against_direct_deque_steps'));assert not result.wasSuccessful()
results.append({'mutation':'大查询循环位置偏移一位','detected':True,'failures':len(result.failures)})
s=Path(__file__).read_text();Path('collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch14-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch':14,'results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(len(results),'种变异检出，源码已恢复')
